brief:
Police detained 325 people during a demonstration Saturday outside the US embassy in London, The Guardian reported. The protest was organized by supporters of Palestine Action, a direct action group facing a legal challenge to its proscription.

The arrests come days before the group plans to challenge the ban at the supreme court on Wednesday. Police have not detailed charges or circumstances surrounding the detentions.
dek: Arrests come ahead of Wednesday’s supreme court challenge to the ban on the direct action group Police have said they arrested 325 people on Saturday at a demonstration outside the US embassy in London against the proscription of Palestine Action.
title: Police arrest 325 at pro-Palestine Action protest at US embassy
